idea-plugin.name: Git Branch Badge
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the current Git branch of your project right in the Project view.

  • Always visible — the project root shows path [branch]: the branch is right where you look for it, and the project path is still there.
  • Always up to date — the label refreshes by itself the moment you switch branches, from the IDE or from a terminal.
  • Detached HEAD too — on a detached HEAD the label shows detached @ abc1234 instead of disappearing.
  • No configuration — nothing to set up, no account, no network call: the branch is read from the local .git/HEAD file, in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, CLion and every other JetBrains IDE.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.1 — First release

  • The current Git branch is shown next to the project root in the Project view, as path [branch]: the project path is kept, the branch is added.
  • The label refreshes by itself when you switch branches, even from a terminal.
  • A detached HEAD is shown as detached @ abc1234 instead of nothing.
  • The project path stays available in the node tooltip.
